pr_summary: Fix for CPU particle simulations failing on WebGPU due to duplicate attribute extraction and unused sampler uniforms. The fix modifies shader-utils.js to handle duplicate attributes gracefully with a warning, and wraps internalTex0/1/2 sampler uniforms in #ifdef PARTICLE_GPU blocks in particle_cpu.js and particle_init.js to prevent unused uniform errors on WebGPU.
environment_management: Standard npm/node_modules. No special environment manager (not using poetry, uv, conda, etc.).
special_system_dependencies: xvfb (for karma tests with Chrome headless)
patch_file_cues: Duplicate attribute handling in shader attribute extraction
Sampler uniforms (internalTex0, internalTex1, internalTex2) for particle systems
test_file_cues: tests/karma.conf.cjs - karma configuration for browser-based tests
platform_constraint_evidence: All build and test commands are cross-platform npm scripts
WebGL/WebGPU targets are web standards, not platform-specific
Karma tests use Chrome which runs on Linux with xvfb
notes: This is a PlayCanvas WebGL game engine repository. The fix addresses WebGPU compatibility issues with CPU particle simulations. The project uses npm for package management, rollup for bundling, mocha/chai for Node-based unit tests, and karma for browser-based tests. The repository is fully cross-platform but CI runs on Linux (ubuntu-latest). No Windows or macOS specific constraints detected.
